title: Orientations of two integer multiplicity triples agree up to sign on the overlap
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P, and let R₁ = (C₁, θ₁, ξ₁) and R₂ = (C₂, θ₂, ξ₂) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n, Simon Ch. 6, 3.1). Write Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Assume that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ C₁ ∩ C₂, every approximate tangent space of C₁ at x is an approximate tangent space of C₁ ∩ C₂ at x, i.e. HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C₁ x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (C₁ ∩ C₂) x Q for every subspace Q. Assume also that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ C₁ ∩ C₂, every approximate tangent space of C₂ at x is an approximate tangent space of C₁ ∩ C₂ at x, i.e. HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C₂ x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (C₁ ∩ C₂) x Q for every subspace Q. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ C₁ ∩ C₂, ξ₂(x) = ξ₁(x) or ξ₂(x) = −ξ₁(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R₁.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier) x Q) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R₂.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier) x Q) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), R₂.orient x = R₁.orient x ∨ R₂.orient x = -R₁.orient x
